title: Senior Director, Growth Marketing
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Director, Growth Marketing

The Senior Director, Growth Marketing is a strategic leader responsible for marketing our flagship Playstation Plus subscription service, and Playstation’s multi-billion-dollar D2C businesses, Playstation Store and Playstation Direct.

Reporting directly to the SVP, Marketing, this role is an integral part of the Playstation Marketing Leadership team and will oversee future growth initiatives at the intersection of digital services, experiences, or community. This individual will lead a geographically dispersed team, driving world-class performance to ensure that it achieves its strategic objectives.

Performance Management

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Push the boundaries of what Coveo can do, one solution at a time

How do you turn ambitious use cases into real, working solutions that prove their value fast? As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you bring ideas to life through hands-on prototyping, transforming complex requirements into tangible, high-impact solutions.

You’ll operate at the edge of what’s possible with Coveo, working directly with customers and internal teams to validate new use cases, push product boundaries, and shape what comes next, before it reaches production.

This role supports our DACH customers, working on European business hours. You’ll own a portfolio of accounts, working in German and English, and travelling to customer sites when the engagement calls for it.

As our Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:

  • Disambiguate customer needs to shape clear, compelling use cases and solution architectures.
  • Build working prototypes and technical proofs based on approved use cases.
  • Translate business and architectural requirements into functional, testable solutions.
  • Validate solution feasibility, performance, and scalability through hands-on experimentation.
  • Iterate rapidly on solutions to accelerate production readiness, generating reusable patterns and sharing insights across teams.
  • Serve as the primary technical owner for assigned DACH accounts, building trusted stakeholder relationships and driving solutions to adoption while working European hours and traveling on-site as required.
  • Deliver workshops, requirements sessions, technical documentation, and demos fluently in German and English.

Here is what will qualify you for the role:

title: Technical Product Manager (Data Platform)
description:
Technical Product Manager (Data Platform)

Location: London

Office requirement: Hybrid, 2x week

Employment type: Permanent

At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to play a key role in our Data Product team in London. If that’s you, and solving complex technical problems at scale gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.


Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔

As our Technical Product Manager, you’ll sit within the Process pillar of the Data Product Team and own the evolution of our next-generation data platform.

You’ll help shape the strategy and lead on the execution of how we ingest, process, validate, govern, and deliver high-quality consumer survey data at scale. This includes accelerating our migration from legacy pipelines into our modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow/Astronomer), while ensuring near-zero disruption to client delivery.

This role is critical to GWI’s future. Our Data Platform underpins everything we deliver to customers — from SaaS insights to APIs and AI integrations. Your work will directly impact how quickly new surveys reach clients, how reliably our data performs at scale, and how efficiently our internal teams operate.

Specifically, you will:

👉 Shape and execute the roadmap for scalable, automated survey processing on our Data Platform
👉 Reduce time from survey completion to client availability through workflow automation, validation frameworks, and release optimisation
👉 Lead migration from legacy pipelines to NDP, sequencing change to deliver early impact while maintaining delivery stability
